name: Vibbhinna
tagline: Designer blouses, lehengas, gowns and silk sarees
about:
Vibbhinna is a designer boutique for bridal blouses, lehengas, gowns, silk sarees and kids wear.
This is a demo catalogue built by OneCatalog to show how Vibbhinna's collection looks in one link. Pick a product and a size, then tap the WhatsApp button to ask about it.
WhatsApp messages from this demo come to OneCatalog.
metaDescription: Vibbhinna demo catalogue. Bridal maggam work blouses, lehengas, gowns, silk sarees and kids wear, each with sizes. Enquire on WhatsApp.

categoryIntros.Designer Blouses: Bridal and festive blouses with maggam work, zari, thread embroidery, puff sleeves and tassels. Pick your size and send it to us on WhatsApp.
categoryIntros.Lehengas: Bridal, reception and festive lehengas in velvet, silk, brocade and net, from deep wine and gold to soft silver, green and royal blue.
categoryIntros.Gowns: Ball gowns and party gowns in net, sequin and brocade, for engagements, receptions, birthdays and photo shoots.
categoryIntros.Sarees and Half Sarees: Silk sarees, half sarees with maggam blouses, and a matching saree and sherwani look for couples.
categoryIntros.Kids: Festive wear for little ones: a kurta and dhoti set for boys and matching net frocks for sisters.
